channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran’s World Cup hopes hit US visa hurdles
item.description: Players from Iran’s national football team are in Turkey applying for US visas for the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Top UN court rules workers’ right to strike ‘protected’ in key treaty
item.description: The nonbinding ruling is expected to be hailed as a victory by workers' groups and influence global labour relations.

item.title: ‘Lingering shock from tragedy’ weeks after Minab school bombing
item.description: Residents are calling for justice weeks after US missiles killed at least 156 people at a school in Minab, Iran.

item.title: Putin and Lukashenko monitor joint Russia-Belarus nuclear exercises
item.description: Moscow and Minsk hold strategic nuclear drills with the two countries' leaders participating via video conference.

item.title: Russia rehearses ‘use of nuclear forces’ in drills with Belarus
item.description: Russia delivered nuclear warheads to sites in Belarus as part of a three-day military exercise involving both countries.

item.title: US-Iran diplomacy picks up: What’s the latest?
item.description: Iranian media reported that the Pakistani interior minister is in Iran to help the US and Iran reach a peace deal.

item.title: Iran steps up claim to control Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran publishes a map claiming "armed forces oversight" across more than 22,000 sq km of the waterway.

item.title: Gaza flotilla activists deported from Israel as backlash over treatment grows
item.description: A video showing a far-right Israeli minister taunting activists who were kneeling with their hands tied behind their backs has been widely condemned.

item.title: Air France and Airbus found guilty of manslaughter over 2009 plane crash
item.description: The companies were found guilty by a French court over an air disaster which killed 228 people.

item.title: DR Congo cancels World Cup training camp over Ebola outbreak
item.description: The outbreak, caused by a rare Ebola species, is thought to have caused 139 deaths so far.
